scene.title: Ionic Bond in NaCl
scene.summary: Sodium donates an electron to chlorine, forming Na⁺ and Cl⁻ which attract each other to create an ionic bond.

entities.text: Na gives an electron to Cl

beats.title: Separate atoms
beats.narration: Sodium (Na) and chlorine (Cl) atoms are shown apart, each neutral.

beats.title: Electron transfer
beats.narration: Sodium donates its outer electron to chlorine, illustrated by an arrow.

check.question: After the electron moves, what happens between Na and Cl?
check.explain: Opposite charges attract, creating an ionic bond.

beats.title: Forming ions
beats.narration: Na becomes Na⁺, Cl becomes Cl⁻, and they attract each other.

beats.title: Recap
beats.narration: The ionic bond in NaCl is the electrostatic attraction between Na⁺ and Cl⁻.
